entries.name: board-v2-normalization-rederives-facts
entries.claim: A Board with zero facts survives a later added field: normalization never re-derives the facts from the List (review finding 1a/1b, active and retired).
entries.replacement:
const derivedFacts = ((model.surfaces.find((s) => s.surfaceId === body.listSurfaceId) as unknown as { list?: { columns: { role: string; field: string }[] } } | undefined)?.list?.columns ?? []).filter((c) => c.role === 'value' && c.field.includes(':field.')).slice(0, 3);
      const self = boardSelfProblem(board) ?? (body.facts.length < derivedFacts.length ? 'Board facts no longer match the List derivation.' : null);

kills.name: proof: from a Board with zero facts, and again after retiring it, adding a field still compiles

entries.name: board-v2-fact-contract-needs-list-column
entries.claim: A chosen fact's contract is the list query's selection, not List column presence, so hiding its column or the title column still compiles (review finding 1c).
entries.replacement: const selected = new Set(((list?.list as { columns: { field: string }[] } | undefined)?.columns ?? []).map((c) => c.field));

kills.name: proof: from a Board with chosen facts, and again after retiring it, relabelling, hiding and reordering a fact column, hiding the title column and narrowing its operation still compile

entries.name: board-v2-retired-board-validated
entries.claim: A retired Board is not validated on normalization: its removed binding does not block the package.

kills.name: proof: normalization checks the recorded digest and each binding by ID, never re-deriving, and skips a retired Board
kills.expected: Board binding northstar\.app:operation\.custom_gone is absent or retired

entries.name: board-v2-normalization-self-digest-omitted
entries.claim: Normalization refuses a Board whose body no longer hashes to its recorded digest.

kills.name: proof: normalization checks the recorded digest and each binding by ID, never re-deriving, and skips a retired Board

entries.name: board-v2-superseded-revision-bound
entries.claim: On replay only the last revision of each Board surface checks bindings, so a retired or rebound Board replays on a base that removed what the first revision bound.

kills.name: proof: active then retired, and active then rebound, replay clean on a base that removed an operation only the first revision bound

entries.name: board-v2-conflict-unattributed
entries.claim: A Board binding conflict on another base is reported with its typed code and the affected ID, never WHOLE_PACKAGE_FAILURE.

kills.name: proof: a base change to a bound operation yields its exact typed conflict naming its ID
proof: a base change to a bound tier o0 to o1 yields its exact typed conflict naming its ID
proof: a base change to a bound retargeted edge yields its exact typed conflict naming its ID

entries.name: board-v2-apply-self-digest-omitted
entries.claim: On the authoring base a Board patch whose body was changed after its digest was taken is refused for its digest.

kills.name: proof: on the authoring base a patch whose digest does not match its recorded IDs and contracts is refused
kills.expected: did not match the regular expression

entries.name: board-v2-apply-exact-digest-omitted
entries.claim: On the authoring base a self-consistent Board patch whose choices this base never offered is refused by the exact digest.

kills.name: proof: on the authoring base a patch whose digest does not match its recorded IDs and contracts is refused

entries.name: board-v2-serving-floor-understated
entries.claim: The serving reader refuses a manifest that carries a Board under the Board v2 rung (review finding 6).

kills.name: proof: the serving reader refuses an understated surface floor, a stated floor without a Board, and a forged move
kills.expected: Board declarations and the surface manifest disagree

entries.name: board-v2-serving-retired-checked
entries.claim: The serving reader does not check a retired Board's bindings, so a release that retired a Board whose operation the base removed is admitted.

kills.name: proof: active then retired, and active then rebound, replay clean on a base that removed an operation only the first revision bound
kills.expected: The Board move must bind the declared lifecycle transition

entries.name: board-v2-company-read-unscoped
entries.claim: A company-scoped Board read returns only the chosen company's cards; the company predicate is the only thing that hides the other company's card.

kills.name: a company-scoped read and move
kills.expected: did not match the regular expression|match the regular expression

entries.name: board-v2-forged-confirm-admitted
entries.claim: A Board confirmation without this server's ticket for the exact reviewed intent is refused with 403.
entries.original:
if (form.boardAction === 'confirm' && !valid(opId))
    return refuse('Open the move again.', 403);

entries.name: board-v2-ungranted-move-offered
entries.claim: A person without the transition grant sees no Move card, even when an automation principal holds it.

kills.name: a move granted only to an automation principal is never offered to a person
